metadata.title: Album Cover with Man on Cliff and Goats

recipe.visualDefinition: A digital painting depicting a man sitting on a rocky cliff overlooking a body of water and a distant city under a dark, purple-hued night sky with a full moon. Several goats are scattered on the cliff and foreground. The overall mood is dark and contemplative.
coreVisualRelationships: The man on the cliff is the central human figure, positioned high and looking down.
The cliff dominates the left and bottom portions of the image, providing a dramatic setting.
The water and distant city provide a sense of expansive landscape and civilization afar.
The goats are integrated into the rocky landscape, adding an element of nature and perhaps symbolism.
The moon and stars illuminate the dark sky, creating a celestial backdrop.
coreInvariants: A lone figure seated on a prominent rock formation.
A dark, atmospheric night sky with a visible moon.
Presence of multiple goats in the foreground and midground.
A body of water and a distant city visible in the background.
Dominant dark and cool color palette with warm accents from the moon and sky gradient.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The main subject, the man, is positioned in the upper right quadrant, scaled to be significant but not overwhelming, allowing the landscape to share prominence. He is seated on a large rock, making him appear elevated.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, dark rock formation on which the man sits serves as the primary visual anchor, grounding the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye is drawn first to the man, then follows the contour of the cliff downwards to the goats, then sweeps across the water to the distant city, and finally up to the moon and sky.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark sky and the expanse of water create significant negative space, emphasizing the isolation of the man and the vastness of the environment. The dark areas of the cliff also contribute to the negative space, framing the lighter elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Dark blues, purples, and deep greens dominate, establishing a nocturnal and somewhat mysterious atmosphere.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: The warm yellow of the moon and the orange/pink gradient in the sky provide strong contrast against the cool, dark tones, drawing attention to the horizon and celestial elements.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Subtle hints of light grey on the goats and the man's clothing, along with the faint glow around the moon, act as accents, providing points of interest.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: The overall image has low to medium saturation, contributing to the dark and moody feel. Values range from very dark in the foreground and cliff to medium-dark in the sky, with bright highlights on the moon and some reflective surfaces.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain a predominantly dark and cool palette.
Ensure the warm sky gradient transitions smoothly.
Limit bright colors to small accent areas.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Sans-serif, bold, slightly condensed, with a subtle western/slab serif influence on some characters.
letterConstructionRules: Characters have slightly rounded corners, particularly on 'M', 'Y', 'U', 'R', 'N'.
The 'Y' has a distinctive, slightly extended right arm.
The 'E' has a slightly extended middle bar.
The 'X' has a slightly wider stance than other letters.
The 'B' has a distinctive, almost '8'-like counter in the upper bowl.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'Y' in 'MY' has a unique, almost calligraphic flourish on its right arm.
The 'R' in 'TURN' has a slightly extended leg.
The 'X' in 'DELUXE' has a slightly exaggerated crossbar intersection.
The 'B' in 'BABY' has a distinctive, almost '8'-like counter in the upper bowl, and the 'A' has a slightly pointed apex.

composition.relationshipToImage: integrated into the midground, appearing to rest on the cliff

treatment.shadow: subtle drop shadow, dark brown/black, offset down-right

composition.scale: medium, about 60% of display text height
composition.relationshipToImage: rests on the cliff, below the main title

treatment.shadow: subtle drop shadow, dark brown/black, offset down-right

composition.position: right of the subtitle, slightly overlapping
composition.scale: small, about 40% of display text height

treatment.shadow: subtle drop shadow, dark grey, offset down-right

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A bold, structured sans-serif for main titles paired with a fluid, handwritten script for a personal touch.
graphicDevices: Parental Advisory Explicit Content label in the bottom right corner.

preserve: The bold, condensed nature of the main titles.
The slightly rounded corners and subtle western/slab serif feel on the main titles.
The handwritten, fluid quality of the script text.
The color scheme of orange-yellow for main titles and white for script.
The subtle drop shadows for all text elements.
avoid: Thin or light weights for the main titles.
Highly decorative or overly ornate fonts for the main titles.
Blocky or overly formal script fonts.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Impact, Compacta, or similar condensed bold sans-serifs with slight modifications
candidateDirections.reason: Captures the bold, condensed, and slightly industrial feel of the main titles, requiring minor adjustments for rounded corners and specific character forms.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Western-style slab serifs with rounded edges (e.g., Rockwell, modified)
candidateDirections.reason: Could provide the sturdy, slightly blocky feel with rounded terminals, but might require more significant modification to remove serifs or condense.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Brush script fonts (e.g., Pacifico, Lemon Tuesday, or custom brush lettering)
candidateDirections.reason: To replicate the fluid, handwritten style of the smaller text, ensuring a natural, personal touch.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate the full image without any text elements. Ensure the cliff, man, goats, water, city, and sky are rendered as described, maintaining the dark, moody atmosphere and color palette.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay the main title 'MY TURN' in a bold, condensed, orange-yellow sans-serif with a dark outline and subtle shadow, positioned on the lower-left cliff. Below it, add 'DELUXE' in a smaller, similar style, slightly indented. To the right of 'DELUXE', add the script text 'BABY' in white with a subtle shadow, at a slight upward angle, partially overlapping 'DELUXE' and the cliff. Finally, add the 'Parental Advisory' label in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Are the main titles bold, condensed, and orange-yellow with a dark outline?
Is the script text white, fluid, and positioned correctly relative to the main titles?
Are all text elements accompanied by subtle drop shadows?
Is the 'Parental Advisory' label present and correctly placed?
Does the text appear integrated with the cliff, not floating?

adjustableVariables: Exact shade of orange-yellow for the main titles.
Thickness and color of the text outlines.
Intensity and offset of text shadows.
Specific texture applied to the text.
Angle and position of the script text.
mustRedesign: Any text that appears flat or lacks the subtle 3D/shadow effect.
Any text that does not have the specified color and outline treatment.
Any script text that looks too rigid or generic.

mustAchieve: A dark, atmospheric, and slightly mysterious mood.
Clear distinction between the foreground cliff, midground water/city, and background sky.
The man and goats must be clearly discernible and integrated into the scene.
The typography must be legible and visually impactful, with the specified treatments.
avoid: Overly bright or saturated colors that detract from the dark mood.
Flat, untextured rendering of the landscape elements.
Generic or uninspired typography that doesn't match the specified style.

postGenerationChecks: Verify that the overall image maintains a dark, nocturnal ambiance.
Confirm that the man, cliff, goats, and distant city are all present and well-integrated.
Check that the typography matches the specified styles, colors, and treatments (fill, outline, shadow).
Ensure the text is positioned correctly and appears to rest naturally on the cliff.
Confirm the presence and correct placement of the 'Parental Advisory' label.
Assess the legibility of all text elements against the background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Recreate the dark, atmospheric landscape with a man on a cliff and goats. Overlay bold, orange-yellow condensed sans-serif text for the main title and subtitle, with a thin dark outline and subtle shadow. Add a white, fluid script text for the artist's name, also with a subtle shadow, positioned to the right and slightly angled. Include the 'Parental Advisory' label.
